title: Escrow Assistant II
description:
Job Description:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
4 - 6 years experience required. Escrow Assistant

Prior to Closing:
• Order payoffs and final utilities for files; verify payoffs match title commitments.
• Handle all file requirements prior to closing, including but not limited to liens, judgments, and bankruptcy requirements
• Obtain most past and present tax information; ensure current taxes have not been paid.
• Order and follow-up on HOA letters, bylaws, financials, and irrigation.
• Obtain commission information on the real estate agents involved in the transaction.
• Disburse files and verify receipt and accuracy of wires.
• Prepare Power of Attorneys and Quit Claim Deeds when necessary.
• Maintain communication with the Escrow Officer regarding status of the file.
• Handle walk-ins or phone calls when Escrow Officer is unavailable.
• Help other assistants and fill in as receptionist as needed.

Closing
• Assist with entering figures from lender.
• Assist with printing documents for closing.
• Print checks for closing.
• Assist with faxing figures to lenders/Realtors.

After Closing
• Clean out file for shipping of loan package, recordings, follow-up on any money held in escrow, etc.
• Prepare closed out file for scanning.

Position Comments:
Need very experienced escrow assistant to work with busy top producer escrow.

title: DevOps/Automation Engineer Sr.
description:
Job Description
Day to Day Responsibilities of this Position and Description of Project:
  • As part of our Cloud Platform Migration Program, we are seeking an engineer experience in data migrations and strong expertise in DevOps and cloud automation. This role is expted to focus on ensuring the safe, accurate, and timely migration of critical data stores, such as Postgres, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, S3, and Kafka (MSK), while also improving workflows, automation, and tooling that empower engineers across the organization.
  • You will work closely with Cloud Platform Engineering, Developer Experience, Data Engineering, and Software Engineering teams to design migration strategies, streamline processes, and ensure smooth adoption of the new platform.

What you will accomplish:

Data Migrations
  • Design and execute migration plans for Postgres, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, S3, and Kafka (MSK).
  • Build and maintain tooling, scripts, and automation for repeatable, reliable migration processes.
  • Validate data integrity, completeness, and performance before, during, and after migration.
  • Troubleshoot schema differences, data consistency issues, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Ensure migrations meet compliance, security, and reliability standards.

DevOps Automation
  • Design, build, and upkeep tools and systems to elevate engineering team productivity.
  • Work with developers to pinpoint and remedy bottlenecks in the development workflow.
  • Advance automation tools for robust CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
  • Develop self-service options for developers to foster independence from other teams.
  • Maintain a stable, scalable, and secure development environment while keeping abreast of the latest DevOps innovations.
  • Craft and maintain clear, accessible internal documentation for migration and development practices.
  • Collect feedback and metrics to continually refine both the developer experience and migration processes.

What you will bring:
  • 5+ years of proven experience as a data migration engineer, DevOps engineer, or software engineer with a focus on developer tools and platform engineering.
  • Hands-on expertise with Postgres, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, S3, and Kafka (MSK) in production environments.
  • Strong coding skills in one or more languages (Python, Go, C#, JavaScript, or similar).
  • Proficiency in migration tooling and techniques (ETL pipelines, DMS, snapshot/restore, replication strategies).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, GitHub Actions) and version control systems (Git).
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong knowledge of cloud services (AWS preferred) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • A passion for improving workflows, developer experience, and enabling successful cloud migration.

title: Application Security Engineer IV
description:
Job Description
Day to Day Responsibilities of this Position and Description of Project:
  • We are looking for a stellar full stack developer who will be responsible for design, development and support of application security tools used by security team and application developers. These tools help securely release eBay's public facing product lines. The ideal candidate person will be a software developer with engineering experience working on Security attacks reduction through foundational product security fixes

Job Requirements:
  • BSCS degree with 7-9 years of experience or an MS degree with 5+ years of experience
  • Up to 5 years of related hands-on product development experience with web applications is required; experience in secure DevOps space.
  • Strong Programming experience in development of user interface of web-based tools (Node.js, React JS, Angular JS)
  • Ability to build automation tools and REST API-s for security processes and web applications on Java (with Spring Boot) and familiarity with databases (Hadoop, noSQL, Oracle, etc) is required. Knowledge of other languages like Python is a plus. Knowledge of GraphQL is plus
  • Ability to deep dive into SAST/DAST/SCA scan data (from Appscan, Checkmarx, semgrep,Snyk) and logs to analyze for security gaps will be a major plus
  • General understanding of Security in CI/CD process and usage of AI tools is expected
  • Working experience with product development teams in a continuous delivery developer role is highly desirable. The developer is expected to be comfortable delivering in short sprints in an Agile framework
  • Ability to clearly articulate issues and communicate in an effective and personable manner.
  • Ability to determine risk based on context and adjust quickly to the security needs of a highly agile organization
  • Highly motivated developer to pick new skills as required and apply to delivery processes.

title: Emission Calibration Engineer
description:
JOB ID: TYARD1449417

Job Title: Emission Calibration Engineer
Duration: 12 Month+
Location: Ann Arbor, MI - 48105

Company Background:
Our client, a major employer in the area, is looking for an Emission Calibration Engineer to be part of its team in its North American operations.

Description:
Skills / Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Calibration of engine control (EFI/OBD) for North America and global markets
  • Complete engine calibration in accordance with procedures to meet regulations and other performance targets (emission, fuel economy, power, drivability and OBD)
  • Prepare and manage calibration and resource schedule to meet development deadlines
  • Test preparation, data collection, data analysis, and technical report creation on a regular basis
  • Build successful relationship with calibration technician group
  • Conduct vehicle testing and development under various tolerance conditions and extreme environmental conditions (hot, cold, high altitude)
  • Complete required internal training necessary for job execution (Technical, Driving, etc.)
  • Perform software logic and value confirmation activities

Requirements:
Required minimum education and experience:
  • A bachelor's degree (or higher) in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
  • Emissions calibration experience in conventional and/or hybrid powertrain
  • Excellent driving record
  • Thorough understanding of internal combustion engine theory/practice
  • Proficiency in MS Office
  • Experience investigating technical issues and creating effective technical solutions

Nice to have:
  • Experience calibrating engine controls for markets other than the US (Japan, Europe, China, etc.)
  • Advanced engineering degree
  • Experience with Model-Based Design processes
  • Experience with other programming languages such as Python, VBA, etc.
  • Proficiency in MS Project
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink/C/C++ programming languages
  • Experience working well in a culturally diverse environment
  • Understanding of Emission and OBD regulations for US and other markets
